title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. translated_title: ALER：面向强化学习的自适应可学习经验重写
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测强化学习（RL）中，后续的观测可能使已存储的信息过时，或改变其对下一步决策的含义。现有的RL记忆架构和基准测试大多只考察记忆保持能力（retention），即将信息原封不动地保存到需要使用时的能力。我们进一步形式化了两个额外的需求：重写（rewriting）将决策相关内容设置为一个与旧值无关的新值，而经验融合（experience fusion）则通过后续观测所指定的规则来转换旧内容。对于由这类更新构建的任务，我们统计了求解所需的最少记忆状态数量，并且若干基线方法在需要更多状态的组合任务上达到了其最低成功率。我们提出了ALER（Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting），一个将LSTM与槽记忆相结合的智能体。其中，一种独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入操作将其权重集中于单个槽并覆盖该槽，同时一个可学习的门控机制用于融合检索到的内容……
tldr: 提出了ALER，一个结合LSTM与槽记忆的强化学习智能体，通过形式化记忆“重写”与“经验融合”两种更新需求，利用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入覆盖单个槽位并用可学习门控融合内容，从而有效应对部分可观测强化学习中记忆需动态更新的任务。
en_tdlr: ALER is an RL agent pairing an LSTM with slot memory that formalizes two memory-update requirements—rewriting and experience fusion—and uses an independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write to overwrite individual slots plus a learned gating mechanism to fuse retrieved content, enabling better performance on partially observable RL tasks requiring dynamic memory updates.
